name: Mock Bisque Soup
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Scald milk with bread crumbs, onion, parsley, and bay leaf.
Remove seasonings and rub through a sieve.
Cook tomatoes with sugar fifteen minutes; add soda and rub through a sieve.
Reheat bread and milk to boiling-point, add tomatoes, and pour at once into tureen over butter, salt, and pepper.
Serve with croûtons, crisp crackers, or Souffléd crackers.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
